def probability_raw(model, row):
    token_ids = prompt_ids(row)
    if len(token_ids) > MAX_LENGTH:
        raise ValueError('Input melebihi MAX_LENGTH')
    x = torch.tensor([token_ids], dtype=torch.long, device=next(model.parameters()).device)
    mask = torch.ones_like(x)
    with torch.inference_mode():
        logits = model(input_ids=x, attention_mask=mask).logits[0, -1]
        pair = torch.stack([logits[LABEL_TOKEN_IDS[0]].float(), logits[LABEL_TOKEN_IDS[1]].float()])
        p = torch.softmax(pair, dim=0)[1].item()
        margin = (pair[1] - pair[0]).item()
    return (p, margin)

import hashlib,json,sys,struct
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
import httpx
sys.path.insert(0,'/home/False9/llama.cpp/gguf-py')
from gguf import GGUFReader
root=Path('/mnt/c/Users/Daffa_At_N/Documents/SIKB amba/diawatch_qwen3_lora_adapter/lora_adapter')
with httpx.Client(timeout=10,trust_env=False) as client:
 props=client.get('http://127.0.0.1:8080/props').json()
 adapters=client.get('http://127.0.0.1:8080/lora-adapters').json()
 base=Path(props['model_path'])
 gguf=Path('models/diawatch-lora.gguf')
 def sha(path):
  h=hashlib.sha256()
  with path.open('rb') as f:
   for block in iter(lambda:f.read(4*1024*1024),b''):h.update(block)
  return h.hexdigest()
 record={'server_build':props.get('build_info'),'model_alias':props.get('model_alias'),
  'base_model':{'file':base.name,'sha256':sha(base),'bytes':base.stat().st_size},
  'gguf_adapter':{'file':gguf.name,'sha256':sha(gguf),'bytes':gguf.stat().st_size},
  'original_adapter':{'file':'adapter_model.safetensors','sha256':sha(root/'adapter_model.safetensors')},
  'active_adapter_ids_scales':[{'id':a.get('id'),'scale':a.get('scale'),'matches_project_adapter_path':Path(a.get('path','')).resolve()==gguf.resolve()} for a in adapters],
  'export_tokenizer_sha256':sha(root/'tokenizer.json'),
  'server_template_sha256':hashlib.sha256(props.get('chat_template','').encode()).hexdigest(),
  'export_template_sha256':sha(root/'chat_template.jinja')}
 raw=(root/'adapter_model.safetensors').read_bytes(); n=struct.unpack('<Q',raw[:8])[0]
 header=json.loads(raw[8:8+n]);data=memoryview(raw)[8+n:]
 reader=GGUFReader(str(gguf));matched=0
 modules={'attn_q':'self_attn.q_proj','attn_k':'self_attn.k_proj','attn_v':'self_attn.v_proj','attn_output':'self_attn.o_proj','ffn_gate':'mlp.gate_proj','ffn_up':'mlp.up_proj','ffn_down':'mlp.down_proj'}
 for tensor in reader.tensors:
  parts=tensor.name.split('.')
  key=f'base_model.model.model.layers.{parts[1]}.{modules[parts[2]]}.lora_{"A" if parts[-1]=="lora_a" else "B"}.weight'
  item=header[key];lo,hi=item['data_offsets'];original=np.frombuffer(data[lo:hi],dtype='<f4').reshape(item['shape'])
  if np.asarray(tensor.data).shape==original.shape and np.array_equal(np.asarray(tensor.data),original.astype(tensor.data.dtype)):matched+=1
 record['tensor_comparison']={'matched':matched,'total':len(reader.tensors)}
 Path('/tmp/diawatch_model_snapshot.json').write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2))
 print(json.dumps(record,indent=2),flush=True)
